body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn. Its next successful attack before your next turn may push one damaged enemy 1 unit, as heated plates flare.

surges.html: The push may be sideways instead.
Also reduce the target's next incoming Fire Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Fire Thread
rider.html: Gain a Fire Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: one target that already took Damage since its last turn takes +1 Damage from that card if hit.
